meta.author: claude
meta.description: Market stall, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Over budget: 83 blocks vs 17 (and 3 x 3 instead of 3 x 2, so the trader has a spot behind the counter). Spruce-post stall with a plank counter under a thin, sloped awning of red and white carpet stripes on trapdoor boards; trader enters from the side; L1 has barrels, a crate, grain and a trade sign; L2 adds the striped wool front edge, lanterns, produce, grain and a shelf; L3 the sign post, banner, stool, back barrel, scraps bin and flowers. Decoration step adds: sign_text.
meta.changes: Quality check: the awning is now one block thick (spruce trapdoor boards with red and white carpet stripes instead of two layers of solid blue wool) and slopes down to the front; level 2 adds a red and white wool front edge one step lower. Goods moved to the front corners and level 1 now has goods too (barrels, a crate, grain on the counter, a trade sign).
